ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels against 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric regions on the lateral lobes; black pigmentation is mapped to the trailing edge boundaries, lateral tips, and a broad central vertical band extending from the peduncle to the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 80 degrees at the central lobe division.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the trailing edge; most prominent peaks located on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature across the trailing edge boundaries terminating in tapered, slightly recurved outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of circular white high-contrast pixel groups localized on the terminal edge of the left fluke tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible traversing the white regions of both lobes, predominantly in diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Accumulated high-contrast circular structures on the left fluke tip and multiple distinct linear surface disruptions across the ventral lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular circular ring-shaped pigmentation feature located in the upper-medial region of the right fluke lobe.
